response.justification: Bogdan has a strong background in software development with experience in C++ (National Instruments), D, and Node.js, but lacks direct experience with modern C++ for geospatial data pipelines or routing systems. His geospatial work (GISCollective) is promising but not deeply aligned with high-scale routing tile optimization. His leadership and full-stack versatility are assets, but the role requires deeper expertise in C++ and distributed systems for routing.
strengths: Strong polyglot development skills (C++, D, TypeScript, Rust exposure implied)
Proven experience with low-latency systems and distributed architectures (Dunnhumby)
Open-source contributions and geospatial platform development (GISCollective)
concerns: Limited direct experience with modern C++ for geospatial/routing pipelines
No clear evidence of working with navigation data or routing algorithms
Recent roles focus on web/mobile stacks rather than core infrastructure (e.g., Re:Cinq, Optilyz)
